'''Axtor Bridgeman''' was an aging [[Tramp freighter/Legends|tramp freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] operating in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] some time during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Axtor first became involved in freighting cargo between the stars when his father was offered a position on a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] by a man named [[Bridgeman]] in return for repair work. Axtor's father signed on immediately and advanced through the ranks. Axtor was given the opportunity to accompany his father on a trip and that experience made Axtor desire to be a freighter [[Captain/Legends|captain]] himself.<ref name="GG6-1" />

Axtor did not want to work for a large commerce guild so he gambled and borrowed a loan from a [[loan shark]], [[Yerkys ne Dago]]. in order to buy his own ship, the ''[[Dynasty]]''. His goal was to repay his loan, and although made enough money to pay the interest, he was unable to reduce the size of his loan.<ref name="GG6-1" />
{{RPGseed}}
While very drunk, he once interrupted [[Tecknel Shnick]] while he was dealing for the transport of a number of crates with some [[Free-trader|free-traders]] at [[Travnin/Legends|Travnin]]'s [[The Grand Design]] and was subsequently hauled off by two of Tecknel's toughs. Tecknel then explained to the free-traders he was dealing with that Bridgeman would have happily taken the job himself but was not deemed fit for the task has he had lost his last 3 cargos to [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Axtor was an easy-going man although he was not one for rules and regulations. He had been hauling freight for a while and had started looking towards retirement if he ever found a way to repay his loan. He was older with greying hair and wrinkles starting to form around his face. He also had the large, strong hands of a mechanic, an inheritance from his father.<ref name="GG6-1" />
